name: CHINHIN
recent: Chin Hin Group Berhad 在2026年11月26日公布季度业绩，同时宣布以RM50.79百万出售子公司Chin Hin Group Property 3.36%股权。此外，公司近期持续进行股份回购，并宣布与PMCK合作在马六甲开发私人医院。
notable: 以RM50.79百万出售Chin Hin Group Property 3.36%股权。
与PMCK合作在马六甲开发私人医院。
近期持续在公开市场进行股份回购。
risks: 执行主席Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon于2026年10月19日间接减持6,500,000股。
董事在闭门期前表示有意进行交易。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM1,052.62百万，环比增长12.9%，同比增长10.3%；净利为RM9.03百万，环比下降55.9%，同比下降59.7%，净利率从2.2%降至0.9%。

recent_en: Chin Hin Group Berhad announced quarterly results on 26 November 2026 and disclosed the disposal of a 3.36% stake in subsidiary Chin Hin Group Property for RM50.79 million.
notable_en: Disposed a 3.36% stake in Chin Hin Group Property for RM50.79 million.
Collaborating with PMCK to develop a private hospital in Melaka.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon indirectly disposed of 6,500,000 shares on 19 October 2026.
Directors indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,052.62 million, up 12.9% QoQ and 10.3% YoY; net income was RM9.03 million, down 55.9% QoQ and 59.7% YoY, with net margin falling from 2.2% to 0.9%.
